Watts printed the hymn under Luke 10:21–22. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

21At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight. 22All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.” LUKE 10:21–22 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ LUKE 10
